result.summary: The page is generally coherent, but the bottom navigation contains an obvious rendering/layout artifact and the second popular restaurant card appears incomplete.

issues.description: A long dark horizontal bar overlaps the center search icon in the bottom navigation and stretches across much of the screen, making the navigation look corrupted.
issues.suggestion: Remove the unintended bar or constrain the active-state indicator to the correct tab dimensions and position it without overlapping the icon.

issues.description: The second card in the “Popular right now” section shows only its image; its restaurant name, metadata, and rating are missing even though there is visible space before the bottom navigation.
issues.suggestion: Render the card’s title and metadata consistently with the first card, or adjust the card/container height and scrolling behavior so the content is not omitted.

issues.description: The category carousel and the “Fastest near you” restaurant carousel are visibly clipped at the right edge, with partial pills and cards displayed.
issues.suggestion: If horizontal scrolling is intentional, add a clearer scroll affordance or ensure the clipping appears deliberate; otherwise constrain items to the viewport.
